description: City of Gainesville Parking Lots is a dataset listed in City of Gainesville open data portal (data.cityofgainesville.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Gainesville. The downtown Gainesville area provides free time limited parking as well as metered and long term parking. This dataset contains spatial locations and selected attributes for off-street parking facilities in the downtown and university areas maintained by the City of Gainesville. Coverage: Gainesville, Florida. The portal files it under the category Mobility. Its tags are parking, parking lots. The table has 48 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation and Mobility. The portal shows 2021-12-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofgainesville-org-portal.
